Samira: Heads-up — All-hands this Thu 10:00 PT / 18:00 UTC. Hybrid (HQ + Zoom). Recording will be uploaded. Please add Qs in Slido: https://app.sli.do/event/abcd1234
Samira: Draft agenda below — add items if needed: 1) Exec update (10m) 2) Product demo (15m) 3) Dedicated & Private launch callouts (10m) 4) Q&A (live + Slido) (20m) 5) Ops & reliability notes (5m) 6) Hiring & org updates (5m)
Samira: If you want to share a 2-min demo snippet, reply here by EOD Tue. We'll pick 2-3 short demos to keep it tight.
Priya: Quick question — can we shift demos later for APAC folks? 10am PT is rough for some teams.
Samira: We're keeping 10am PT to match exec availability, but we'll publish a timestamped recording + a 3-bullet TL;DR afterwards so APAC folks can catch highlights quickly.
Jordan: I can demo the new routing policy UI (2m). Adding here so Taylor can slot me.
Taylor: I'll collect demo volunteers and run a short rehearsal Wed 11:30 PT — @Jordan @Lena please join rehearsal if you want to ensure smooth handoff.
Lena: Yep I can join Wed rehearsal.
DevOps Bot: Calendar event created: All-hands — Thu 10:00 PT. Link: https://meet.example.com/room/ai-111
Samira: Small ask: drop 1–2 example questions in Slido now so folks have prompts to upvote. Also flag anything you want us to call out in the launch section.
Maya: Accessibility note — live captions will be on and we'll add an auto-transcript. If you need other accommodations DM me and we'll sort it.
Jordan: For the Private launch callouts, can we highlight the migration checklist and data residency notes? I can prepare 3 slides for that.
Samira: Great, slotting that right after product demo.
Taylor: Rehearsal invite sent (Wed 11:30 PT) — calendar shows optional for those just syncing demos.
Priya: Will the recording have timecodes/chapters? That helps folks jump to launch details.
Samira: Yes — we'll publish a highlights doc with timestamps and short action items after the meeting.
Calendar Bot: Reminder scheduled: 1 hour before meeting.
Samira: Final logistics: Qs for the live Q&A due by Wed noon — we'll triage and surface the top 10. :thumbsup:
Lena: Dropping quick pre-read: https://drive.example.com/file/d1 — please skim before Wed rehearsal.
Jordan: I'll upload a short screen recording of my demo 15m before the meeting in case screen share issues appear.
DevOps Bot: Post-call: recording (and auto-transcript) will be posted here when ready: https://videos.example.com/rec/1763848210
Samira: Thanks everyone — after the meeting we'll open a follow-up thread for action items and owners. If you've got anything urgent to include under Ops, drop it here before EOD Tue.
